artworks.title: Elisha Bringing the Blinded Syrian Army to the King of Israel
artworks.artist: Antonio Tempesta
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient battle scene with soldiers and a city backdrop. The image depicts an organized procession of soldiers and horses, carrying spears and banners, moving towards a walled city. In the foreground, some soldiers are seen pointing and observing the scene, wearing armor and helmets with distinct plumes. The background is filled with architectural structures typical of an ancient city, featuring towers and a gate that suggest a fortified settlement. The scene is highly detailed, with fine lines capturing the mood and action of the era depicted. Latin text inscriptions are included at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Exterminating Angel Vanquishing the Army of Sennacherib
artworks.artist: Antonio Tempesta
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic battle scene. The image depicts a dramatic battlefield filled with chaos and motion. Numerous soldiers and horses are in a state of frenzy amidst what appears to be a sudden attack or disaster. In the foreground, there are several figures either fallen or in various poses of distress, with a central focus on a large fallen warrior lying on the ground. Behind them are tents, while in the background, more soldiers and riders can be seen advancing. A figure with wings seems to be descending from the sky above the scene. The landscape features a fortified city in the distance. The illustration is intricately detailed with dynamic lines emphasizing movement and turmoil.

artworks.title: Josaphat Thanking God for His Victory
artworks.artist: Antonio Tempesta
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with numerous figures and tents. The image depicts figures engaged in various activities across a landscape. In the foreground, two individuals are collecting or examining objects scattered on the ground, which include various vessels and possibly armor. Behind them, a group of helmeted and armored figures stand, some blowing trumpets and others holding flags. To the left, figures appear to be organizing or preparing to move. Further back, tents and figures and animals, including elephants, stretch into the distance, suggesting a large camp or gathering. The background displays a rolling landscape with mountains under a sky. The style of the lines and the detailing suggest a classical or Renaissance influence.

artworks.title: Judith and Holofernes
artworks.artist: Antonio Tempesta
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a camp scene with detailed elements. An elaborately dressed figure is emerging from a tent, while another figure is partially obscured inside the tent, reaching towards something on the ground. The tent has intricate textile patterns and there are other elements like furniture inside. Outside, there are various tents in a campsite. A large fire burns in the background, casting shadows. Horses are grazing nearby, along with individuals resting or being active.

artworks.title: The Israelites Rebuilding the Walls of Jerusalem
artworks.artist: Antonio Tempesta
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This depicts a medieval city scene under construction. Workers are building what appear to be fortifications or city walls. The scene shows workers engaged in construction activities, including working with tools, sculpting stones, and hewing timber. Arches frame workers in the left, while an ox-drawn carriage is seen on the right. In the background, elephants are leading a procession towards the city gate. The architectural structures include crenellations and arches typical of medieval style.

artworks.title: Rainy Landscape
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vosterman, after Lodewijk de Vadder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated viewpoint, displaying the terrain extending into the distance. The horizon is high in the composition with a village consisting of small buildings and trees. The sky has fine lines indicating movement, potentially rain, blending into detailed, swirling clouds. In the foreground, there is a dirt path surrounded by rocks and tall grass. The background displays hills with trees, leading to the horizon. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic palette of browns and grays.

artworks.title: Rainy Landscape
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vosterman, after Lodewijk de Vadder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated position looking across a countryside scene. The horizon, about one-third from the top of the image, is defined by a line of trees and a distant settlement that includes a church-like structure with a spire. Fine, diagonal lines across the sky suggest rain, with a contrast between the cloudy sky and the rain-covered area. The technique uses delicate hatching and cross-hatching brushstrokes throughout, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia or dark brown ink on a lighter background. Closest to us, a rugged, rocky terrain with a path is bordered by trees on the right. In the distance, there are rolling terrain and wooded areas.

artworks.title: Count Nicolas Zrinyi
artworks.artist: Mathis Zundt
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a bearded man shown from the waist up. He is positioned with his upper body turned slightly to the side, gazing directly at the viewer. His facial features are prominent with a full beard and a serious expression, and he wears a distinctive hat adorned with a large feather plume. The man's clothing is richly detailed, featuring a patterned coat with a high collar and buttons. He is holding a set of keys in his left hand, which rests on a surface. Surrounding the figure, there is an ornate frame that integrates elaborate illustrations, including musical instruments, helmets, and various objects. In the background, a detailed landscape is visible, depicting scattered buildings and trees, under a sky with a winged figure holding a cross in the clouds. The overall artwork is intricately designed with an emphasis on engraved patterns and historical details.

artworks.title: Title Page for "De droeve Ellendigheden van den Oorloogh"
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative text page surrounded by figures in historical attire and military elements. The main section of the image is occupied by text in a classical serif font introducing the title. Surrounding the text are intricate illustrations; to the left are figures wearing ornate, period-specific clothing, possibly soldiers given their armor and weapons like halberds and swords. The right side mirrors this design, with more similarly attired figures. Below the text, a variety of military paraphernalia like drums, trumpets, and cannonballs are artistically arranged along with heraldic elements such as flags and a crown. The drawing is characterized by fine lines and high contrast between the ink and background paper, typical of detailed engraving techniques.

artworks.title: Recruitment of Troops
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: A drawing of a military camp scene with soldiers assembled. Soldiers are in orderly rows, holding spears or rifles. In the foreground, individuals in military attire are gathered around a table with coins and items. Tents are visible in the background, along with fortified walls and a tree with sprawling branches.

artworks.title: The Battle
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic battle scene. The detailed etching depicts horses and soldiers in various states of action, some charging into battle while others lie fallen on the ground. In the background, dense smoke billows upwards, blending into the lines used to create a cloudy sky. The foreground features fallen soldiers and horses strewn across the battlefield. The fringes of the battle extend to fortified structures on the hills at the edges of the image. The overall intensity is captured through the swirling lines and overlapping figures, creating a vivid portrayal of battle.

artworks.title: Scene of Pillage
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a scene of a brawl outside an inn. Multiple individuals are fighting, some with swords. The setting is a cobbled street near a building with a gabled roof. In the background, there are people on horseback and trees. The drawing includes details like a sign on the building and individuals looking out of windows. The scene is depicted with fine lines and precision, capturing the tension of the moment.

artworks.title: Plundering a Large Farmhouse
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic interior space filled with figures engaged in various activities. Individauls are moving about, gesticulating, and interacting with each other. The space is detailed, with objects hanging from above, including pots, pans, and kitchenware, suggesting the setting is a large kitchen or workshop. Barrels and stacks of plates line the walls. In the center, figures lean over a table, possibly involved in a transaction or discussion. To the right, others are engaged in an intense action next to an open flame with rising smoke. The composition conveys a sense of urgency and disorder.

artworks.title: Destruction of a Convent
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical town setting. The drawing shows a densely populated town scene with a prominent building featuring classical architectural features such as columns, arches, and statues. In the foreground, there is a commotion involving cavalry on horseback and disheveled individuals. Objects like swords, containers, and belongings are scattered on the ground. In the background, figures are seen, some in groups with poles. The detailed line work captures the texture of the buildings, garments of the individuals, and conveys a sense of urgency and disorder.

artworks.title: Plundering and Burning a Village
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic village scene with buildings on fire and animals amidst the commotion. The drawing depicts a scene of distress and disruption. The village consists of several houses, some of which are in flames with smoke billowing into the sky. In the foreground, numerous animals like cows and sheep are depicted, some being herded by individuals. There are carts laden with goods or possibly people, and evidence of hurried movement with many figures carrying personal belongings or leading livestock. The composition is dense with detail, capturing a moment of crisis, with structures in various states of damage and a bustling human and animal presence conveying urgency and disorder.

artworks.title: Attack on a Coach
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene in a wooded area with a path and two figures on horseback in the background. The artwork features intricate etchings for texture and detail, focusing on foliage, clothing, and facial expressions. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of black and white for contrast. The scene includes a figure by a tree and an ambush on a carriage with figures in motion. In the distance, there are birds flying in the sky.

artworks.title: Discovery of the Criminal Soldiers
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The scene is depicted from a slightly elevated viewpoint, showing a group of figures and a landscape. The horizon is placed moderately low, with trees and a small structure in the distance. The style of the artwork features fine, detailed lines and hatching, giving texture and depth to the elements. The color palette is monochromatic, in black and white. Closest to us, a group of soldiers is shown, with one soldier on horseback leading the group towards the right side where another figure appears subdued. Lush trees frame the path, with naturalistic details throughout the scene.

artworks.title: The Strappado
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This scene depicts a large gathering in a town square, featuring a gallows structure with a suspended figure. Surrounding the gallows are onlookers and soldiers, some carrying flags and others holding spears or pikes. The background includes buildings with steep gabled roofs, portraying an urban setting reminiscent of a European town square. The composition is detailed, with various figures and architectural elements creating a sense of activity and purpose. The drawing is characterized by intricate line work and historical etching precision.

artworks.title: The Hanging
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene of execution in a military camp. In the center, a large tree dominates the composition with numerous figures hanging from its branches. Beneath the tree, the ground is scattered with what appears to be discarded garments or bodies. In the foreground, there are soldiers with muskets and a drummer boy. Two additional groups are shown in discussion or observation. The background shows a large encampment with many tents. The detailed line work conveys the somber atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: The Firing Squad
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts a military scene with soldiers and camp tents. The drawing shows soldiers, some on horseback and others on foot, holding long guns, marching in columns towards a camp. Flags and banners with ornate patterns are visible among the soldiers. Smoke is seen coming from the firing of muskets. In the background, a castle or fortress stands atop a hill, while tents and supplies are visible. The soldiers are depicted in detailed uniforms and gear, with some of them pointing as if giving orders or directions. A dog is also present in the foreground. The artwork features intricate linework typical of etching styles from historical periods of significant military campaigns.

artworks.title: The Stake
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military camp scene. The drawing features soldiers in a highly detailed and organized composition. There are soldiers in formation, carrying various weapons, occupying much of the horizontal span of the drawing. A line of soldiers extends across the center and back of the image. Above the soldiers, there are wavy lines representing clouds or smoke, while in the backdrop, buildings, including a church with a cross, appear to be on fire. Details in the foreground include figures engaged in physical activities. The drawing conveys a sense of historical or narrative depth, capturing a moment of tension and activity.

artworks.title: The Wheel
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a public execution scene with a large crowd gathered around a raised platform. One figure is lying on the platform, while another figure stands ready to strike with a weapon. The setting is outdoors with medieval architecture in the background, including towers and fortifications. Soldiers with pikes and flags are present as well. The composition is crowded with figures, indicating a significant event with a serious and dramatic atmosphere. The costumes and expressions suggest a historical context, potentially of European influence.

artworks.title: The Hospital
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a lively urban street scene with detailed architecture and a group of people engaged in various activities. The setting includes a city square surrounded by buildings, one of which has a dome and classical architectural features. The street is filled with individuals interacting, conversing, and walking. In the foreground, a group appears to be experiencing a scene of hardship, while others are shown performing tasks such as drawing water from a well in the center of the square. The structures exhibit a historical European architectural style with multiple windows and stone facades, offering a glimpse of city life in a past era.

artworks.title: Dying Soldiers by the Roadside
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a street scene viewed from a distance with a low horizon line and a road stretching into the distance. There are people engaged in various activities along the road, with trees framing the scene on either side. The illustration style appears to be a detailed etching, with cross-hatching and linear strokes providing texture to the elements. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of black, gray, and white creating a historical atmosphere. Close to the viewer on the left, figures are resting under a tree, while further ahead, a group of people gather near buildings. The background fades into a less defined cluster of trees and structures.
